**What’s new**
- When an episode finishes, the next one in the series starts - Near the end, Up next names that episode so you can play it now or skip it - If a film or episode pauses to buffer, it carries on from the same place instead of jumping back to the start - Home opens without freezing on a large playlist - Last channel and the TV guide wait until the window is ready to use - Home no longer freezes while live sports, films and the player all update at once - When an episode finishes, the next one can start on its own - Settings can pick a preferred soundtrack and subtitle language - Playlist names can hide extra tags such as 4K and FHD - Home can show trending films and series that are already in your playlist - While you watch, you can search channels, open recent channels, lock the controls, and see stream info - Live picture can fit, fill or stretch, and you can turn deinterlace on for old broadcasts
